kurz: Basil, pine nuts, cheese and oil become a green paste: the gentler the chopping, the greener and more fragrant it stays.
bild_im_kopf: Like greenery in summer rain: the less it is crushed, the fresher it stays.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Toast the pine nuts golden in a dry pan
schluesselmomente.warum: Roasted flavours make the pesto rounder.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Crush the basil in a mortar or with short pulses of the blender
schluesselmomente.warum: A blender left running warms the leaves: the enzymes work faster and the pesto turns dark.

schluesselmomente.schritt: For bright green: blanch the leaves for 10 seconds and refresh in iced water
schluesselmomente.warum: The brief heat switches off the browning enzymes, and the green stays.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Stir in cheese and oil at the end and cover with oil
schluesselmomente.warum: The layer of oil keeps air out and slows darkening.
